query: SELECT pc.id, pc.mes, pc.ano, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lancamento_custo WHERE periodoCustoId = pc.id) as lancamentos, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custo_setor_equipamento WHERE periodoCustoId = pc.id) as equipamentos, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custo_setor_despesa WHERE periodoCustoId = pc.id) as despesas FROM periodo_custo pc WHERE pc.ano = 2026 ORDER BY pc.mes;
